notes: YFDToken (src/YFDToken.sol) is a fixed-supply OpenZeppelin v5.1.0 ERC-20: name Yield Fields Deed, symbol YFD, 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 YFD (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, the launch factory. No other code path mints, so the supply can never grow. Transfers, approvals and transferFrom are plain ERC-20 with no fee, tax, burn, reflection or rebasing, so the factory's transfer to the distributor, the single-sided pool seed through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager and every swap move exactly the amounts they state; the token needs no exemptions and takes none of the launch placeholders. There is no owner and no administrative function: nothing can pause, freeze, blacklist, seize or burn a holder's balance, and the runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT. No application contracts are deployed with this launch. The pool pairs with IMD on Robinhood Chain at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the supply.
